title: The Basket Passed over the Gate
youtube_title: The Basket Passed over the Gate | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Two careful pairs of hands can do what one rush cannot.
summary: At a harbor dock where baskets are passed up, a basket passed over a gate that did not need climbing will go wrong if one person rushes. Delia and Ilaria split it into two slow jobs, while Uncle Idris only offers a count or a name for the knot they need. They finish together.
